BEFORE YOU STOP BY

A FEW GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Have something else on your mind?
Call (310) 691-9772

Do I need an appointment?

Call the shop before visiting to check current availability and arrange your visit. A time is only confirmed when you speak with the team.

How much will my repair cost?

Pricing depends on your vehicle, the parts required, and the work needed. Call with your vehicle details to discuss an estimate; an inspection may be needed before a final quote.

What should I have ready when I call?

Your vehicle’s year, make, and model, along with a description of the issue. Mention when it started and whether you’ve noticed noises or warning lights. Our visit planner helps organize those details.

Where is the shop located?

Find R & K Muffler at 4623 Artesia Blvd, Unit 4, Lawndale, CA 90260, in Artesia Auto Plaza. Look for Unit 4 when you arrive.

What are your current opening hours?

We’re open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:30 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday. All hours are Pacific Time. Please call (310) 691-9772 to confirm holiday hours or arrange your visit.
